description:
Relive the golden era of Bollywood with "Tumsa Koi Pyaara" from Khuddar! 🌟 Featuring the charming duo Govinda and Karisma Kapoor, this 90s hit is brought to life by the melodious voices of Kumar Sanu and Alka Yagnik. Dive into the nostalgic vibes of this classic romantic song and let it take you back to the magical 90s. 💖🎶
